$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-21-batch-o/2026-10-21-batch-o.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

decisions.question: Curved lot fronts: survey arc frontage
decisions.recommendation: Do not prefer a survey frontage measured along a curved front lot line; keep the calculated frontage. Survey preference stays for straight-fronted lots.

decisions.question: Ward-code normalisation timing
decisions.recommendation: Bundle the parked ward two-digit fix and its backfill into the next CoA capture night.

decisions.question: House with secondary suite unit count
decisions.recommendation: house_with_secondary_suite has house_units = 2 (Planning Act s.35.1(1)(a), EXT-prov-1).

decisions.question: Suite side-yard leak from newly keyed exceptions
decisions.recommendation: Apply the M-267 / F-SC-7 unit_application pattern so exception side-yard figures bind the principal building, not garden or laneway suites, for the newly keyed exceptions.
